Title screen, pause, options and shop
Buttons mode: a quick tap outside the on-screen buttons is a mouse click on that spot; the switch button (top left) changes to the Menus layout.
Gestures mode: drag on the left half to move the cursor, tap on the left to confirm (A), two-finger tap to go back (B).
Mouse mode: drag moves the pointer and a tap clicks the menu item under it.
How the touch screen plays. Read when the game starts.
The PC game reads it as an XInput (Xbox) controller
Without a saved mapping the controller goes straight to the game. A saved mapping (test screen above) replaces it for that controller from the next game start.
Drag on the right side: camera
Drag on the left half: move
Tap on the right: light attack
Long press on the right: strong attack
Tap on the left: jump / confirm
The chosen driver is used from the next game start.
